$comment: Thresholds of pipeline:ign-match. PROVISIONAL (2026-10-01): chosen before looking at the score distribution, to be calibrated against the 15 approved rivers and the report's distributions, then recorded in DECISSIONS.md. coverage = fraction of a reach within bufferM of the lines carrying one IGN name; margin = coverage of the best name minus the runner-up. bufferM 250 follows the IGN gate (HydroRIVERS comes from a coarse grid, so positions are offset).
